verdict.rationale: The GitHub README lists official SDKs for TypeScript, Java/Kotlin, Python, Go and Rust. First-party docs cover the SDK APIs: durable steps, timers, error handling, testing utilities, typed clients and changelogs for the TS and Rust SDKs. Hands-on community reports confirm the TS SDK got an existing app running in a few steps, and the AI-assistant plugin teaches coding agents the SDK APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Restate supports the following SDKs: * [Typescript] * [Java and Kotlin] * [Python] * [Go] * [Rust]
The Restate SDK client library lets you invoke Restate handlers from anywhere in your application.

The Restate plugin teaches your coding agent how to build Restate apps: Durable Execution, service types, SDK APIs, common pitfalls, and AI agent integration patterns across TypeScript, Python, Java, and Go.
I used it for an existing app + restate TS sdk, really took a few steps to get things up and running!
